audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says 'Yi has no way to close the gap' and whys[2]/early say a level-3 Wallop kills him 'before Alpha Strike is even available'. Four real interactions are absent from the page entirely: Alpha Strike's untargetability, Meditate's channel and healing, Wuju Style's true damage, and Highlander's slow immunity.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is a 600-range dash he can have from level 1 — he is not gapless, the window is between casts. It also makes him untargetable in flight, so a Boomerang or Wallop spent into the dash is simply wasted, which is the most common way this lane is thrown. Meditate is an interruptible channel that heals and reduces damage: Wallop or GNAR! cancels it outright, and Grievous Wounds cuts what does land — that is what actually happens at levels 4-5, not vague 'lifesteal'. Wuju Style grants true damage on his autos, so armour is the wrong answer to his first-item spike. And Highlander makes him immune to ALL slows for 85 seconds, which switches off Boomerang's slow and GNAR!'s slow — the two tools the whole kiting plan rests on. That last one reframes the post-6 game and was nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Gap-closer claim corrected in whys[0]; untargetability written into early; Meditate's channel and anti-heal into whys[2], whys[3] and the new spikes[3]; Wuju Style's true damage into whys[5] and late; Highlander's slow immunity into whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.
